entries.name: Elemental selenium powder
entries.caption: Source-qualified identity reference; no source-measured molecular geometry. Analytically pure powder. Typical characterization solution is selenium-saturated ethylenediamine; saturation concentration and absolute mass are unreported. No selenium allotrope or molecular geometry is assigned. In the benzene and tetrahydrofuran controls, selenium powder does not dissolve; the successful ethylenediamine route instead uses a selenium-saturated solution. No amount or selenium phase specified.
